serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: I got that all recorded! No takesies backsies!
What?! Why would he reveal himself?! Now he knows it all has been a scam!
Landlord: Jacobi?! All of this was a trap?! Damn you!
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: I had to get back at you for snitching on me on that perjury case!
Landlord: That was like 7 years ago you moron! 
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: You know what they say, wounds on the disciplinary record heal the slowest.
Landlord: It was you who made up a bunch of lies about me!
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Sure, I did, but you didn’t have to be such a sore loser about it.
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Well anyway, I used one of your tenants to get back at you. Completely manipulated the boy so that I could go one up in our feud!
Landlord: It’s actually tied…
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: Sure, keep telling yourself that.
Landlord: Scram out of my building before I call the police!
Jacobi E. Wunderanwalt: I’m free to visit my client wherever I want! It’s not like I need him anymore, anyway.
